# mvgam

> mvgam is an R package for Bayesian State-Space models of univariate and multivariate time series. brms writes the observation model, from a formula in brms syntax. mvgam adds a latent dynamic process to it, from a second formula (`trend_formula`), and fits the model in Stan.

The observation formula takes the brms syntax: smooths from mgcv, random effects, distributional regression, monotonic effects and nearly every brms family. The latent process is a term in `trend_formula`: `RW()`, `AR()`, `CAR()`, `VAR()`, `ZMVN()`, `PW()` or `LLT()`. Each accepts covariates, correlated process errors (`cor = TRUE`), dynamic factors (`n_lv`) and hierarchical grouping (`gr`, `subgr`). mvgam adds families for occupancy (`occ()`), N-mixture (`nmix()`), compositions (`diri()`, `multi()`, `categ()`) and Tweedie data (`tweedie()`). `jsdgam()` fits joint species distribution models.

Fitted models work with the time series functions (`forecast()`, `hindcast()`, `lfo_cv()`, `score()`). They also work with the brms post-processing functions (`loo()`, `pp_check()`, `conditional_effects()`) and with the marginaleffects package. VAR fits add impulse responses (`irf()`), variance decompositions (`fevd()`) and stability measures (`stability()`). Version 2.0 replaced the version 1 argument `trend_model`. Code that passes it fails.

Example:

```r
library(mvgam)
fit <- mvgam(
  y ~ s(x, k = 5),
  trend_formula = ~ AR(p = 1),
  data = dat,          # long format: one row per series and time
  family = poisson()
)
forecast(fit, newdata = dat_test)
```

## Getting started

- [Overview of the mvgam package](https://nicholasjclark.github.io/mvgam/articles/mvgam_overview.md): the two formulas, a first model and how to interpret it
- [Formatting data for mvgam](https://nicholasjclark.github.io/mvgam/articles/data.md): the long data format with its series and time columns, missing values, irregular times
- [Function reference](https://nicholasjclark.github.io/mvgam/reference/index.md)
- [Changelog](https://nicholasjclark.github.io/mvgam/news/index.md): every change from version 1

## Key reference pages

- [mvgam()](https://nicholasjclark.github.io/mvgam/reference/mvgam.md): fit a model
- [Trend constructors](https://nicholasjclark.github.io/mvgam/reference/trend_constructors.md): the arguments of each latent process
- [mvgam_formula()](https://nicholasjclark.github.io/mvgam/reference/mvgam_formula.md): the observation and trend formulas
- [Observation families](https://nicholasjclark.github.io/mvgam/reference/mvgam_families.md)
- [get_prior()](https://nicholasjclark.github.io/mvgam/reference/get_prior.md): default priors and how to change them
- [forecast()](https://nicholasjclark.github.io/mvgam/reference/forecast.mvgam.md): forecasts carry the fitted trend forward in time
- [predict()](https://nicholasjclark.github.io/mvgam/reference/predict.mvgam.md): predictions from covariates leave the fitted trend out
- [jsdgam()](https://nicholasjclark.github.io/mvgam/reference/jsdgam.md): joint species distribution models
